items: 【enhances work comfort】This ergonomic monitor riser elevates your screen to a comfortable eye level, effectively reducing neck strain by preventing you from hunching over your desk, ultimately enhancing your overall work comfort.

【Organized Storage】This desk monitor stand/organizer features two tiers of storage for files and notes. Equipped with two pen holders and a drawer , it effortlessly organizes pens, scissors, and other desk essentials, keeping everything within reach.

【Industrial Style + Natural Eclectic Aesthetics】The natural charm of wood perfectly complements the reliable rust-proof metal, blending rustic appeal with a stylish tech atmosphere. It offers both functionality and aesthetics, matching any office decor style. This adds a touch of sophistication to your workspace, making it ideal for both offices and homes.

【Stable and Durable】The computer stand is crafted from premium wood and high-strength solid steel, delivering exceptional load-bearing capacity. It securely holds up to 44 pounds without wobbling and maintains structural integrity over prolonged use. Featuring adjustable-height feet at its base, this stand ensures steadfast stability on any surface.

【Effortless Setup】Simplicity is key. With no complex assembly, this versatile desk organizer sets up in just 3 minutes. Perfect as a laptop stand, printer riser, or desktop organizer, it adapts to your needs in offices, dorm rooms, and homes.
